description: A detected section's block ID (block:15B-23B), once in the file. build_layout_docs.py stops on an ID that is not a detected section of block_lengths.csv, and on a detected section other than an OS block that has no row here.

What the Layout documentation page (www/behind/layout-docs.html) says the section is, in its list of detected sections: Yard track Y1, Passing siding. The section's name beside it comes from the device master.
